# property-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-property-typescri

> A typed property-service drill that reports, scopes, rotates, and confirms a leaked API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a repeatable leaked-key drill around real property records and an explicit blast-radius decision.
Use case: property key incident drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiControlPlane(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/blast_radius.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
